citation.authors: Simental-Mendia M, Ortega-Mata D, Acosta-Olivo CA, Simental-Mendia LE et al

cited_by.title: Collagen for hair, nails and joints

record.population: Adults with knee osteoarthritis in 11 randomised trials (451 on collagen, 419 on placebo)
record.finding: Collagen supplements improved function (mean difference -6.46) and pain scores (-13.63) compared with placebo. Results varied widely between trials (I2 75% for function, 88% for pain). The authors conclude it relieves osteoarthritis symptoms.
record.note: Ethnicity not reported in the abstract. High heterogeneity lowers confidence.
